title: The Friday update
do: In Home, type /, pick Write the weekly update, send with no text. Copy the Full tab. Approve the Changelog card.
offScript: That is outside what this demo can show. The six things it can do are listed in Settings, under Demo.

variants.label: Full
variants.body:
Shipped
- Table areas on the booking page ([[tickets/jira/GST-140]]), live since 2026-07-14. Guests pick window, terrace or bar when they book.
- One reminder per booking, whatever the source ([[tickets/jira/BOK-412]]), fixed 2026-07-17 after four support tickets.

Changed
- No-show fees is now aimed at end of October, told to [[customers/brasserie-lund]] on 2026-07-16. The [[tickets/jira/BOK-300]] stories go to sprint planning on 2026-07-22.

Watch
- Group bookings still waits on deposits ([[tickets/jira/PAY-210]]), and Payments has given no date.
- Waitlist text ([[tickets/jira/BOK-265]]) is in progress. Left: the 15-minute window and the hand-off to the next guest.

variants.label: Short
variants.body:
Shipped: table areas on the booking page ([[tickets/jira/GST-140]], 2026-07-14) and the reminder fix ([[tickets/jira/BOK-412]], 2026-07-17), so guests who book through Google get one reminder, not two.
Changed: no-show fees ([[tickets/jira/BOK-300]]) is now aimed at end of October, told to Brasserie Lund on 2026-07-16.
Watch: group bookings still waits on deposits ([[tickets/jira/PAY-210]]), and Payments has given no date.

input.body:
## 2026-07-17

Table areas. Guests can pick a table area (window, terrace or bar) when they book. Name your areas once, and the booking list shows the area next to the table. A restaurant with no areas set sees no change.

One reminder for Google bookings. Guests who book through Google now get one reminder, the day before.
input.rationale: This week's section for the public Changelog: the two things a restaurant can use now. Plain words, no ticket keys, no customer names, no target dates, because every restaurant reads this page.

turns.text: Two things shipped this week, the no-show fee date moved to end of October, and group bookings still waits on Payments.
